issues.on_page: Property 2,144,074 (p2, Statement of Activities); General Fund Taxes 2,512,695 (p8)
issues.issue: The subtraction split is valid: the only other taxes, nonmajor 16,022, equal the printed Lodging tax, so General Fund taxes = Property + Motor vehicle exactly. But the piece equals a printed breakdown row, and under the 2026-11-04 standard original_label/source_page could be that row ('Property' -> Property Tax, p2). The budget 2,715,000 is not carried on either piece.
Same as detail[0]: the piece equals the printed SoA 'Motor vehicle' row, but the label and page are kept from the parent line.
The page prints it under Public Works, but county communications is usually dispatch (public safety). This is a judgment call; the line is already marked review.
Broad 'Intergovernmental' group with no breakdown. Calling it highway allocation is an assumption.
The page does not say what the capital outlay bought, so 'equipment purchases' is an assumption ('not itemized' would be the neutral choice).
The function of the Inheritance Tax Fund capital outlay is not printed. Labelling it 'Capital Outlay: General Government' is an assumption.
